summary: Selected proposal 1, the sole cross-review survivor, and exhaustively audited the smallest authorized redundant-signature rank N=8. Among 490314 signature multisets, 403973 are SNF-saturated and 13457 pass the local thresholds. The best code uses signatures 0001, 0010, five copies of 0110, and 1001. Its complete emitted 8x8 affine/boundary matrix has determinant one, legal energy 8, and exact unrestricted false-fiber energies 160,64,56,56. Independently, the verifier constructs a multiplication-closed maximal order in the definite quaternion algebra (-3,-17), identifies its two-sided prime above 17, and exactly certifies minimum nonzero trace energy 34. Therefore min_false=56>=34 and 56/8>17/16. This is a finite depth-one NAND survivor only; COPY, depth two, and all-depth filtration remain unproved.
hypothesis: Causal mechanism: redundant binary coordinate signatures can increase the norm of every unavoidable integral affine NAND pseudosection while preserving binary legal energy. Expected move: a saturated emitted decoder whose complete false-fiber minima meet the independently derived quaternion-prime threshold and exceed legal energy by 17/16. Falsification condition: any signed, affine, or DROP point below either gate. The best N=8 candidate passes this local discriminator.

tests.finding: Exhausted all 490314 N=8 signature multisets, certified saturation completeness, found 13457 local survivors, verified the best determinant-one module and exact false energies, and independently derived prime trace minimum 34 from an explicit maximal order and ideal.
Two complete verifier runs produced byte-identical JSON.
